findings.message: "#tp0" has CSS `transform: translateX(-40px) rotate(-4deg)` and a GSAP tween animates x. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateX(-40px) rotate(-4deg)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: x: -40. Example: tl.fromTo('#tp0', { x: -40 }, { x: -40, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.
